origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): the request as the Python SDK (google-genai) writes it: the top level in camelCase and the messages inside it in snake_case (inline_data, mime_type, parameters_json_schema, thinking_budget, function_calling_config), the image in the URL-safe base64 alphabet. A relay is given the image, the system prompt, the function with its parameters and the thinking level in the form it reads; Kiro and the Anthropic keys are given the request as the entry has always converted it. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
